newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic rose 5 percent in May.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic rose 5 percent in May.

text.p: Spain's Gran Canaria airport handled 5.0 percent more cargo in May compared with the same month last year, the island's airport authority said.
Volume rose to 2,567 tonnes compared with 2,445 tonnes, taking the accumulated total this year to 17,989 tonnes, 15.7 percent more than the same period in 1996.
The airport also handled 483 tonnes of mail in May, 8.3 percent less than in May 1996. The accumulated mail total was up 3.9 percent at 2,400 tonnes.

Passenger numbers were 4.1 percent higher in the month at 532,543 excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 3.33 million, 2.6 percent ahead of 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
